_doc: Recorded paths in the halls (design/ruins/tech-plan.md §6), played by `+ play_path <id>` as a cutscene. keys: [seconds, x, y] in sim px, as the figure walked them; reverse: play the recording backwards (it faces where it walked, so it backs away); face: you (it watches you the whole time); hold: seconds the scene stays after the last key; ghost: drawn in the Hours' light (a replay of the past); captions: [seconds, text].

captions: Someone is standing in the hall, facing you.
Then it goes backwards, faster than anyone could run, and never turns round.
Through the fallen stair, as if the stone weren't there.
The clock's hands run back to the Eclipse, and the hall fills with its light.
A man in the Provost's robes crosses the hall in a hurry.
He doesn't look round. He is going up, toward the Orrery.
